buildings.academy.label: Preaching Hall
buildings.academy.desc: Elders lecture on the Dao. +20% science production; raises science and culture caps
buildings.academy.flavor: Curiosity is the basis of science. Our cats died nobly
buildings.accelerator.label: Star River Array
buildings.accelerator.desc2: Storage bonuses remain effective even if powered off.
buildings.aicore.label: Artifact Spirit Core
buildings.aicore.desc: FelineOS, a state of the art artificial intelligence. Absolutely harmless. Every level of upgrade will increase Core energy consumption by 75%.
buildings.aicore.flavor: I think we can purr our differences behind us. For science.
buildings.amphitheatre.label: Dao Forum
buildings.amphitheatre.desc: A stage for immortal ballads. Produces culture and raises its cap
buildings.amphitheatre.flavor: Daily 'All Dogs Go to Heaven' showings
buildings.aqueduct.label: Spirit Canal
buildings.barn.label: Granary
buildings.barn.desc: Provides a space to store your resources.
buildings.barn.flavor: Rats ain't a problem for us!
buildings.biolab.label: Herb Garden
buildings.biolab.desc: Improves effectiveness of catnip refinement by 10%. More effective if powered.
buildings.broadcasttower.label: Message Tower
buildings.broadcasttower.desc: Broadcasts far and wide—produces culture and raises its cap, boosted by surplus energy
buildings.calciner.label: Metal Calciner
buildings.calciner.desc: A highly effective source of metal. Consumes 1.5 minerals and 0.02 oil per tick. Produces iron and a small amount of titanium
buildings.calciner.desc.automation: Automation converts {0}% of iron output into steel.
buildings.chapel.label: Offering Hall
buildings.chapel.desc: Produces a bit of culture and faith per tick. May be improved with religious upgrades
buildings.chronosphere.label: Reincarnation Hall
buildings.chronosphere.desc: Relocates small amount of resources through time. Can be upgraded further. Every Chronosphere increases the chance of Temporal Paradox.
buildings.dataCenter.label: Jade Slip Vault
buildings.dataCenter.desc: Increases total effect of compendia on your max science
buildings.factory.label: Puppet Workshop
buildings.factory.desc.automation: Automation cleans pollution from the air.
buildings.field.label: Spirit Field
buildings.field.desc: Plant some catnip to grow in the village. Fields have +50% production in Spring and -75% production in Winter
buildings.field.flavor: 'Nip as far as the eye can see.
buildings.gatherCatnip.label: Gather spirit grain
buildings.gatherCatnip.desc: Gather some spirit grain in the woods
buildings.harbor.label: Spirit Boat Dock
buildings.harbor.desc: Provides a space to store your resources
buildings.hut.label: Thatched Hut
buildings.hut.desc: Build a thatched meditation hut. Each hut yields a trickle of cultivation (~+0.04/s)
buildings.hydroplant.label: Water Spirit Array
buildings.hydroplant.desc: A modern source of power production
buildings.ivoryTemple.label: Ivory Temple
buildings.ivoryTemple.desc: Mystical temple where ivory is converted into minerals
buildings.library.label: Scripture Pavilion
buildings.library.desc: A hall of manuals and tomes. Produces insight passively; each level also improves science output by 10%
buildings.logHouse.label: Spiritwood Lodge
buildings.logHouse.desc: Build a spirit-wood lodge that grows timber on its own (~+0.1 wood/s)
buildings.lumberMill.label: Spiritwood Mill
buildings.lumberMill.desc: Produces wood passively and increases wood output by 10%
buildings.magneto.label: Qi Gathering Pile
buildings.magneto.desc: Improves your total resource production by 2%. Every Steamworks will boost this effect by 15%. Consumes oil.
buildings.magneto.phantoms: Up to {0} inactive Magnetos can contribute to the production bonus.
buildings.mansion.label: Manor
buildings.mansion.desc: A spacious manor with quiet chambers that yield cultivation (~+0.1/s)
buildings.mine.label: Spirit Stone Mine
buildings.mine.desc: Delve the spirit-stone vein: minerals trickle in. Each level improves mineral output by 20%
buildings.mint.label: Spirit Mint
buildings.mint.desc: Produces luxurious resources proportional to your max catpower. Consumes catpower and a bit of gold.
buildings.observatory.label: Star Observatory
buildings.observatory.desc: Increases the chance of astronomical events by 0.2%
buildings.observatory.flavor: Yearning to one day catch the red light fairy
buildings.oilWell.label: Earthfire Spring
buildings.oilWell.desc: Produces a bit of oil, +1500 to maximum oil limit
buildings.oilWell.desc.automation: Automation consumes energy for more oil production.
buildings.oilWell.flavor: Rise early, work hard, strike oil.
buildings.pasture.label: Beast Pen
buildings.pasture.desc: Provides an alternative source of food, which reduces catnip consumption.
buildings.pasture.flavor: Take a pint o' milk, Sir!
buildings.quarry.label: Darkstone Quarry
buildings.quarry.desc: Quarries each improve your mining efficiency by 35% and produce a bit of coal
buildings.quarry.flavor: It's full of mice! Wait, wrong 'quarry'
buildings.reactor.label: Earthfire Array
buildings.reactor.desc: Provides a 5% boost to production while active. Requires uranium to operate.
buildings.reactor.desc.automation: Automation consumes thorium to produce more energy.
buildings.reactor.flavor: Glowing mice are much easier to catch!
buildings.refineCatnip.label: Refine spiritwood
buildings.smelter.label: Artifact Forge
buildings.solarfarm.label: Qi Gathering Array
buildings.solarfarm.desc: Provides an additional source of energy depending on the seasons.
buildings.spaceport.label: Spaceport
buildings.spaceport.desc: Increases the storage capacity of buildings in space. Does not affect science or antimatter.
buildings.spaceport.flavor: I want the fancy yarn imported from Yarn.
buildings.steamworks.label: Mechanism Hub
buildings.steamworks.desc: When active, significantly reduces your coal production. Does nothing useful by default, but can do a lot of cool stuff once upgraded.
buildings.steamworks.desc.automation: Automation crafts some materials if they're at the limit.
buildings.steamworks.flavor: I just nap here and it looks like I'm working
buildings.brewery.label: Spirit Brewery
buildings.brewery.desc: Brew catnip into a spicy drink. Boosts festival effects.
buildings.brewery.flavor: Sir! Want some nip' in ya milk?
buildings.temple.label: Ancestor Shrine
buildings.temple.desc: Temple of light. Produces culture. May be improved with Theology.
buildings.tradepost.label: Trading Post
buildings.tradepost.desc: The heart of your trading empire. Improves trade effectiveness by 1.5%, reduces rare resource consumption by 4%
buildings.unicornPasture.label: Qilin Garden
buildings.unicornPasture.desc: Allows the taming of unicorns. Reduces catnip consumption by 0.15%
buildings.warehouse.label: Sumeru Storehouse
buildings.warehouse.desc: Provides a space to store your resources
buildings.workshop.label: Artisan Hall
buildings.workshop.desc: Provides a vast variety of upgrades. Improves craft effectiveness by 6%
buildings.zebraForge.label: Zebra Forge
buildings.zebraForge.desc: Unlocks the craft of bloodstones and t-mythril.
buildings.zebraOutpost.label: Zebra Outpost
buildings.zebraOutpost.desc: Provides a base for the hunting expeditions. Every level of upgrade improves expedition effectiveness by 5%
buildings.zebraWorkshop.label: Zebra Workshop
buildings.ziggurat.label: Ancient Altar
buildings.ziggurat.desc:
The dark legacy of the lost race. Every Ziggurat will improve your culture limits by 8%.
May have special usage once Theology is researched.
buildings.stasisPod.label: Stasis Pod
buildings.stasisPod.desc: A large stasis pod suited for non-feline liveforms

challendge.energy.desc:
Restart the game with consumption of energy multiply by 2.

challendge.pacifism.effect.desc: You gain improved trade based on trade posts.

challendge.postApocalypse.desc:
A ruined, polluted timeline. Purge it with your cave-heaven's power—pollution hurts more.
Warning: no turning back
challendge.postApocalypse.effect.desc: Increases amount of cryochambers that can be operational. Unlocks special policies for this run.
challendge.postApocalypse.flavor: 'Surely it's not that bad' they thought

challendge.unicornTears.desc:
Restart the game, except unicorn-related resources are required for many things, and storage space is limited.

challendge.unicornTears.effect.desc: Unicorn Tombs increase max faith (scales with transcendence tiers). Reduce the ivory price ratio for Ziggurat religion.
challendge.winterIsComing.label: Winter Has Come
challendge.winterIsComing.desc:
Restart the game with only winter seasons. (Catnip will not benefit from paragon production bonus)

Goal: Get to Helios.

policy.autocracy.label: Autocracy
policy.autocracy.desc: Autocratic rule channels spirit veins. +5% manpower; unlocks new policies
policy.bigStickPolicy.label: Big Stick Policy
policy.bigStickPolicy.desc:
Speak softly, but carry a big stick. No race dares slight your caravans.
+5% trade effectiveness
policy.carnivale.label: Carnivale
policy.carnivale.desc: Feasts and revelry spread your fame. +5% culture production
policy.cityOnAHill.label: City On A Hill
policy.cityOnAHill.desc: Be a shining example to the world you hate. Culture cap is slightly increased.
policy.clearCutting.label: Clear Cutting
policy.clearCutting.desc: Totally destroy the forest in an effort to improve your wood production.
policy.clearSkies.label: Clear skies
policy.clearSkies.desc: Clear night skies—the stargazers approve. Improves observational bonus
policy.cryochamberExtraction.label: Immortalism
policy.dragonRelationsPhysicists.label: Dragon Relations: Physicists
policy.dragonRelationsPhysicists.desc: Dragon physicists are experts on nuclear energy. They can help by improving your reactors.
policy.dragonRelationsAstrologers.label: Dragon Relations: Astrologers
policy.dragonRelationsAstrologers.desc:
The dragons have a long standing tradition of studying celestial objects. Work together with dragon astrologers to study the stars and get a look into their unique understanding of them.
Each year spent in a cycle increases starchart production
policy.dragonRelationsDynamicists.label: Dragon Relations: Dynamicists
policy.dragonRelationsDynamicists.desc: Motion is an important concept in dragon society. For that reason they have a whole branch of scientists who study specifically locomotion and its intricacies. Dragons can improve your varying forms of travel.
policy.terraformingInsight.label: Space expansionism
policy.terraformingInsight.desc: Insight into world-shaping. Terraforming stations yield +10% cultivation
policy.communism.label: Communism
policy.communism.desc: Industrialization at all costs. Increases production of coal, iron, and titanium, and makes factories cheaper.
policy.conservation.label: Conservation
policy.conservation.desc: Preserve the land and its veins. -5% pollution
policy.culturalExchange.label: Cultural Exchange
policy.culturalExchange.desc: Your poets and actors will travel to foreign lands, slightly increasing culture income.
policy.diplomacy.label: Open Borders
policy.diplomacy.desc: Build good relationships with your neighbors, making trades cheaper in terms of catpower.
policy.environmentalism.label: Environmentalism
policy.epicurianism.label: Epicurianism
policy.epicurianism.desc: Luxuries for the self alone. Unlocks several new policies
policy.expansionism.label: Cosmological Libertarianism
policy.expansionism.desc: Privatize the moon! Nothing changes on Cath, but unobtainium production will be increased.

science.acoustics.label: Acoustics
science.acoustics.desc: Acoustics is the study of sound. Though not obviously useful, in a long run it may benefit civilizations thriving for cultural and religious development.
science.advExogeology.label: Exometallurgy
science.advExogeology.desc: Exometallurgy studies new methods of unobtainium processing
science.agriculture.label: Spirit Farming
science.agriculture.desc: The basis of all civilised life, Agriculture allows the working of land for food. Agriculture can significantly improve your food production.
science.ai.label: Artificial Intelligence
science.ai.desc: Artificial Intelligence is an attempt to create a machine capable of reasoning and performing cognitive tasks.
science.ai.effectDesc: Unlocks Neural Networks and AI Core
science.animal.label: Animal Husbandry
science.animal.desc: Domestication allows access to various animal resources via the pasture. Improves your food production.
science.antimatter.label: Antimatter
science.antimatter.desc: Antimatter provides some advanced sources of energy and generally benefits scientific advancement
science.antimatter.effectDesc: Unlocks Antimatter Reactors, AM-Drive, AM-Fission and Antimatter Bases
science.archeology.label: Geology
science.archeology.desc: Geology is the science comprising of the study of Cath, the rocks of which it is composed, and the processes by which they change. Can potentially benefit your mining industry.
science.archeology.flavor: Different fossils of giant lizards were discovered. Apparently they all died in a sudden but inevitable betrayal.
science.archery.label: Archery Arts
science.archery.effectDesc: Unlocks zebra outposts and related buildings
science.architecture.label: Architecture
science.architecture.desc: Architecture allows construction of some new sophisticated structures.
science.architecture.flavor: A tower tall enough to pluck the stars
science.astronomy.label: Astronomy
science.astronomy.desc: Astronomy is the study of objects in space. Improves scientific development.
science.artificialGravity.label: Artificial Gravity
science.artificialGravity.desc: New anti-G engines enable a new form of long-range space travel.
science.biochemistry.label: Biochemistry
science.biochemistry.desc: Improves your chemistry and biology-related technologies.
science.biochemistry.flavor: Some of the things that molecules do.
science.biology.label: Biology
science.biology.desc: Biology deals with living organisms, their characteristics and their use in our society. Improves science and chemistry industry.
science.biology.flavor: The secrets of evolution are time and death
science.blackchain.label: Blackchain
science.blackchain.desc: All cool cats are mining this, so I think it is some kind of mineral
science.brewery.label: Catnip Processing
science.brewery.desc: Catnip Processing is a non-mandatory technology which improves the process of converting catnip to catnip wood.
science.calendar.label: Calendar
science.calendar.desc: Develops the ability to predict when the seasons will change. This ability is essential for advanced agriculture.
science.calendar.effectDesc: Calendar provides a way of more precise time tracking
science.chemistry.label: Alchemy
science.chemistry.desc: The discovery of Chemistry allows the deeper study and understanding of natural elements and their interaction. As a result new resources may be unlocked.
science.chronophysics.label: Chronophysics
science.chronophysics.desc: Chronophysics studies the nature of time and possibilities of temporal manipulations
science.chronophysics.effectDesc: Unlocks Chronospheres, Flux Reactors and Stasis Chambers
science.civil.label: Civil Service
science.civil.desc: Establish rules to govern the estate
science.combustion.label: Combustion
science.combustion.desc: Combustion provides a number of ways to improve old coal-based automation technologies, such as Steamworks.
science.combustion.effectDesc: Unlocks Offset Printing, Oil Refinery and Fuel Injection
science.construction.label: Construction
science.construction.desc: Construction represents the advancement of the study of masonry, primarily by adding iron and other metals to the builder's toolbox. Benefits hunting and base infrastructure.
science.construction.effectDesc: Allows your workers to construct the Lumber mill. Unlocks Composite Bows
science.cryptotheology.label: Cryptotheology
science.cryptotheology.desc: Cryptotheology applies the most arcane and unorthodox methods of theology in order to answer the fundamental questions of the universe and reality.
science.cryptotheology.effectDesc: Unlocks Relic Station and Cryptotheology tree
science.currency.label: Currency
science.currency.desc: Currency represents a certain amount of wealth. Can significantly boost your development in indirect ways.
science.dimensionalPhysics.label: Dimensional Physics
science.dimensionalPhysics.desc: Dimensional Physics explores the concepts of space and time
science.drama.label: Drama and Poetry
science.drama.desc: Drama and poetry are both forms of artistic expression. Improves cultural progress.
science.ecology.label: Ecology
science.ecology.desc: Ecology is a technology primarily focused on the search for new cheap and safe energy sources.
science.electricity.label: Thunder Calling
science.electricity.desc: Electricity unlocks a new way to automate production, benefiting the catkind in all different areas.
science.electricity.flavor: Who knew running around on the carpet could generate such power?
science.electronics.label: Electronics
science.electronics.desc: Electronics unlocks some high level upgrades mainly related to science
science.electronics.effectDesc: Unlocks Broadcast Towers, CAD Systems, Refrigeration and SETI
science.engineering.label: Engineering
science.engineering.desc: Engineering is the science (or art perhaps) of designing complex materials, structures, devices, and systems.
science.exogeology.label: Exogeology
science.exogeology.desc: Exogeology or Planetary Geology studies extraterrestrial metals and minerals.
science.exogeophysics.label: Exophysics
science.exogeophysics.desc: A study of geophysics on a massive scale of planetary bodies
science.genetics.label: Genetics
science.genetics.desc: Technology that further improves upon biology and chemistry. Affects your food industry.
science.genetics.flavor: There's an unbroken thread that stretches from those first cats to us.
science.hydroponics.label: Hydroponics
science.hydroponics.desc: A pinnacle of space engineering, hydroponic provides new sources of food supply for our distant colonies.
science.industrialization.label: Industrialization
science.industrialization.desc: Industrialization represents the concept of mass-producing materials, from food products to machine parts.
science.machinery.label: Mechanism Arts
science.machinery.desc: Previous advances in metal working and science give birth to the concept of a machine, a device with multiple moving parts. Machinery introduces a concept of automation which reduces routine operations
science.machinery.effectDesc: Unlocks Steamworks, Crossbows, Printing Press and Factory Automation.
science.math.label: Mathematics
science.math.desc: Mathematics is the most basic building block upon which all physical science is based. Improves scientific development.
science.math.effectDesc: Allows construction of Academies, very efficient research buildings
science.math.flavor: Purr equals Meow times Paw to the square
science.mechanization.label: Mechanization
science.mechanization.desc: Mechanization provides a lot of ways to automate redundant tasks; hence improving craft, oil pumps and construction technologies.
science.metal.label: Metal Working
science.metal.desc: The first metal-working technology that provides your civilisation with sturdy, durable tools.
science.metal.effectDesc: You can construct Smelters that convert ore into metal
science.metalurgy.label: Metallurgy
science.metalurgy.desc: Metallurgy improves the process of metal production, benefiting Smelters and Calciners
science.metaphysics.label: Metaphysics
science.metaphysics.desc: Metaphysics is a traditional branch of philosophy concerned with explaining the fundamental nature of being and the world that encompasses it. Absolutely useless.
science.mining.label: Ore Seeking
science.mining.desc: Mining develops the ability to extract mineral resources from the bowels of Cath.
science.mining.flavor: Pickaxes are easier to hold with opposable thumbs
science.nanotechnology.label: Nanotechnology
science.nanotechnology.desc: Nanotechnology is manipulation of matter on an atomic, molecular, and sub-molecular scale. Can potentially improve your energy and resource production.
science.nanotechnology.effectDesc: Unlocks Nanosuits, FL Reactors, Augmentations and PVC
science.navigation.label: Navigation
science.navigation.desc:
Navigation allows serious advancements in sailing and shipbuilding technology. It should benefit economical development and can lead to discovery of new civilizations.
(Hint: You don't need to have all of this culture at once)
science.navigation.effectDesc: Unlocks the construction of Trade Ships and overseas trade.
science.nuclearFission.label: Nuclear Fission
science.nuclearFission.desc: Nuclear Fission unlocks Nuclear Reactors and nuclear-related upgrades
science.nuclearFission.effectDesc: Unlocks Nuclear Reactors and Nuclear Vessel
science.oilProcessing.label: Oil Processing
science.oilProcessing.desc: Unlocks advanced options of oil processing
science.orbitalEngineering.label: Orbital Engineering
science.orbitalEngineering.desc: Orbital engineering—build advanced constructs among the stars
science.orbitalEngineering.effectDesc: Unlocks Space Stations and the Hubble Telescope
science.paradoxalKnowledge.label: Paradox Theory
science.paradoxalKnowledge.desc: Develop a framework for understanding and controlling the time-space continuum.
science.paradoxalKnowledge.flavor: Knock that bowl off your grand-cat's table for fun and profit.
science.particlePhysics.label: Particle Physics
science.particlePhysics.desc: Particle physics takes us one step deeper into the understanding of the nature of matter and energy than its ancestor, Nuclear Physics
science.particlePhysics.effectDesc: Unlocks Particle Accelerators, Railguns and Enriched Uranium
science.particlePhysics.flavor: Mewtrinos are strongly and electrically aloof.
science.philosophy.label: Dao Inquiry
science.philosophy.desc: Philosophy is the first abstract science developed by catkind. Philosophy is a basis of spiritual and cultural progress.
science.physics.label: Physics
science.physics.desc: Physics is a study of laws of nature. Mostly improves your machinery effectiveness.
science.quantumCryptography.label: Quantum Cryptography
science.robotics.label: Robotics
science.robotics.desc: Robotics improves automated structures like Calciners
science.robotics.effectDesc: Unlocks Steel Plants, Hydro Plants, Tankers and Rotary Kilns
science.rocketry.label: Rocketry
science.rocketry.effectDesc: Unlocks construction of spaceships and oil processing
science.sattelites.label: Satellites
science.sattelites.desc: Satellites are machines that permanently orbit the planet outside its atmosphere
science.sattelites.flavor: Spreading cat videos at the speed of light
science.steel.label: Steel
science.steel.desc: Development of the new Steel alloy advances further metal working. Benefits most of the aspects of development.
science.superconductors.label: Superconductors
science.superconductors.desc: Superconductors are exotic materials that help to optimize energy efficiency of different technologies
science.superconductors.effectDesc: Unlocks Cold Fusion and Space Manufacturing
science.tachyonTheory.label: Tachyon Theory
science.tachyonTheory.desc: Tachyonic particles are hypothetical particles that always move faster than light.
science.terraformation.label: Terraformation
science.terraformation.desc: Terraformation technology focuses on use of the antimatter to change the climate of the Cath System exoplanets
science.theology.label: Ritual Canon
science.theology.desc:
Theology is the study of religion. Religion is a key concept affecting cultural, scientific and industrial development.
(Hint: You don't need to have all of this culture at once)
science.theology.flavor: What is that flaming ball in the sky anyway?
science.thorium.label: Thorium
science.thorium.desc: Thorium is an extremely radioactive and energy efficient isotope that can be used in various space era upgrades.
science.thorium.effectDesc: Unlocks Thorium Reactors and Thorium Engine
science.voidSpace.label: Void Space
science.writing.label: Talisman Script
science.writing.desc: Inscribe the Dao on talismans—unlocks the amphitheatre and transcription arts
science.writing.flavor: Writing uses less ink than pawprints
space.ground.control.label: Ground Control
space.centaurusSystemMission.label: Centaurus System Mission
space.centaurusSystemMission.desc: Centaurus System is a warm faraway star system.
space.charonMission.label: Charon Mission
space.charonMission.desc: Charon is small, incredibly dense and distant dwarf planet on the far edge of the Helios system. It is so hostile and barren that it is sometimes referred as 'The Gates of Death'
space.duneMission.label: Dune Mission
space.duneMission.desc: Dune is a large and lifeless planet covered by sand and volcanic rock.
space.furthestRingMission.label: Furthest Ring
space.heliosMission.label: Helios Mission
space.heliosMission.desc: Helios is a G2V spectral type star in the center of Cath's solar system.
space.kairoMission.label: Kairo Mission
space.kairoMission.desc: Kairo is a dwarf planet in the far end of Cath's solar system.
space.moonMission.label: Moon Mission
space.moonMission.desc: Launch a rocket to Redmoon, a Cath planet satellite
space.orbitalLaunch.label: Orbital Launch
space.piscineMission.label: Piscine Mission
space.piscineMission.desc: Piscine is a gigantic aquatic planet composed of an acid body and a methane atmosphere
space.planet.cath.label: Cath
space.planet.cath.sattelite.label: Satellite
space.planet.cath.sattelite.desc: Deploy a Satellite. Satellites improve your Observatory effectiveness by 5% and produce starcharts
space.planet.cath.spaceElevator.label: Space Elevator
space.planet.cath.spaceElevator.desc: Every Space Elevator reduces oil requirements for all space projects by 5% and improves all space structures' production efficiency by 1%
space.planet.cath.spaceStation.label: Space St.
space.planet.cath.spaceStation.desc: Deploy a space station. Each station boosts science output and provides space for 2 astronauts
space.planet.centaurusSystem.label: Centaurus System
Every level of Molten Core improves Tectonic effectiveness by 5%
space.planet.centaurusSystem.tectonic.de: Rip open the planet near the star Centaurus to collect magma energy.
space.planet.charon.label: Charon
space.planet.charon.entangler.label: Entanglement St.
space.planet.charon.entangler.desc: Entanglement Station generates a set of entangled particles aka qbits for your quantum computing system. This process requires an enormous amount of processing power, but lets you perform a cryptographic attack on elder encryption algorithms.
space.planet.dune.label: Dune
space.planet.dune.hydrofracturer.label: Hydraulic Fracturer
space.planet.dune.hydrofracturer.desc: Produces a high-pressure stream of oil. Every Space Elevator will boost this production by 0.1% of the global production multiplier.
space.planet.dune.planetCracker.label: Planet Cracker
space.planet.dune.planetCracker.desc: USS Mining Vessel Hissmeowra that can crack an entire planet
space.planet.dune.spiceRefinery.label: Spice Refinery
space.planet.dune.spiceRefinery.desc: Refines the sand of the Dune into a highly psychoactive substance known as 'Spice'.
space.planet.furthestRing.label: Furthest Ring
space.planet.helios.label: Helios
space.planet.helios.containmentChamber.d: Containment Chamber. Increases antimatter storage space by 100.
space.planet.helios.heatsink.label: Heatsink
space.planet.helios.heatsink.desc: A heat dissipation system. Every Heatsink will increase the power consumption of Containment Chamber by 1% and antimatter storage capacity by 2%
space.planet.helios.sunforge.label: Sunforge
space.planet.helios.sunforge.desc: Uses the heat of the sun to smelt materials into supercondensed plasma. Every level of Sunforge improves the storage space of your base metals by 1%
space.planet.helios.sunlifter.label: Sunlifter
space.planet.helios.sunlifter.desc: Generates antimatter once per year. Inactive if energy production is negative
space.planet.kairo.label: Kairo
space.planet.kairo.spaceBeacon.label: Space Beacon
space.planet.kairo.spaceBeacon.desc: An AM-powered space station used for research and interstellar navigation.
space.planet.moon.label: Redmoon
space.planet.moon.moonBase.label: Moon Base
space.planet.moon.moonBase.desc: Establish a base on a surface of Redmoon
space.planet.moon.moonOutpost.label: Lunar Outpost
space.planet.moon.moonOutpost.desc: Deploy a nuclear powered mining outpost on Redmoon
space.planet.piscine.label: Piscine
space.planet.piscine.orbitalArray.label: Orbital Array
space.planet.piscine.orbitalArray.desc: Provide a 2% production bonus to all space structures
space.planet.terminus.label: T-Minus
space.planet.terminus.cryostation.label: Cryostation
space.planet.umbra.label: Umbra
space.planet.umbra.hrHarvester.label: HR Harvester
space.planet.umbra.hrHarvester.desc: Hawking Radiation Harvester. Operates on the energy of the black hole evaporation. Every HR Harvester generates 1W of energy which slowly increases over time.
space.planet.umbra.navigationRelay.label: Navigation Relay
space.planet.umbra.navigationRelay.desc: Increase your crew cap by one
space.planet.umbra.spaceShuttle.label: Space Shuttle
space.planet.yarn.label: Yarn
space.planet.yarn.hydroponics.label: Hydroponics
space.planet.yarn.hydroponics.desc: State of the art automated hydroponic system. Increase catnip limit by 10%. Increase catnip production by 2.5%
space.planet.yarn.terraformingStation.de: Explode a charge of antimatter to melt yarn ice and throw oxygen into the atmosphere
space.panel.rorshach.label: Guixu Comet
space.rorschachMission.desc: Rorschach is the biggest comet near Helios.
space.rorschachMission.label: Rorschach
space.mission.rorschach.complete.log.msg: Rorschach is impenetrable but you see farther now.
space.terminusMission.label: T-minus Mission
space.terminusMission.desc: Terminus is a supermassive ice giant at the far end of Cath's solar system.
space.umbraMission.label: Umbra Mission
space.umbraMission.desc: Umbra is a supermassive black hole at the heart of the Helios system
space.yarnMission.label: Yarn Mission
space.yarnMission.desc: Yarn is a class M planet with high moderate climate, seas and oxygen atmosphere.

time.AccelerateTimeBtn.label: Tempus Fugit
time.AccelerateTimeBtn.desc: Accelerate and slow time at your whim (+50% speed up)
time.cfu.blastFurnace.label: Chrono Furnace
time.cfu.blastFurnace.desc: Operates on chronoheat. Increases the maximum heat limit by 100.
time.cfu.blastFurnace.desc2: Automation skips one year into the future for each 100% of fuel consumed.
time.cfu.controlledDelay.label: Controlled Delay
time.cfu.controlledDelay.desc: Each one makes the Chrono Furnace wait 0.2 seconds before firing again.
time.cfu.controlledDelay.desc2: Toggling automation has no gameplay effect.
time.cfu.ressourceRetrieval.label: Resource Retrieval
time.cfu.ressourceRetrieval.desc: Retrieve part of your yearly resources when you burn TC
time.cfu.temporalAccelerator.label: Temporal Accelerator
time.cfu.temporalBattery.label: Temporal Battery
time.cfu.temporalBattery.desc: Improves your flux energy capacity by 25%
time.cfu.temporalPress.label: Temporal Press
time.cfu.temporalPress.desc: Allows for fine tuning of shattering
time.cfu.temporalPress.desc.automation: Automation increases the custom shatter amount by a factor of 5.
time.cfu.temporalImpedance.label: Time Impedance
time.cfu.temporalImpedance.desc: Delay effect of Dark Future temporal penalty by 1000 years.
time.cfu.timeBoiler.label: Time Boiler
time.cfu.timeBoiler.desc: Expands the heat capacity of Chrono Furnaces.
time.chronoheat: Temporal heat is generated by Time Crystal shattering and decreases over time. Every 1 unit of heat over the limit will increase Time Crystal shattering price by 1%
time.fixCryochambers.label: Fix Cryochamber
time.fixCryochambers.desc: Tear the space-time continuum to get back a Cryochamber before it was used.
time.flux.desc: Temporal flux can be regenerated over time when game page is closed

time.use.heat.desc:

time.vsu.chronocontrol.label: Chronocontrol
time.vsu.chronocontrol.desc: Increase the duration of Temporal Paradox
time.vsu.cryochambers.label: Cryochamber
time.vsu.cryochambers.desc:
Freeze the soul in ice—each chamber grants +0.01 cultivation/tick
One chamber per chronosphere level

time.vsu.usedCryochambers.desc: Unsealed Cryochamber. Not in operating condition.
time.vsu.voidHoover.label: Void Hoover

time.vsu.voidResonator.label: Void Resonator

cultivation.fate.shijin.story: By chance you acquire a nest of primordial Gold-Devouring Beetles. Released, they pour out like a golden flood—refined iron, precious metals, all become your foundation. Their shed shells make fine relic-craft too.
cultivation.fate.yinyue.label: Silvermoon
cultivation.fate.yinyue.story: Yinyue, a silver moonfox sealed in a jade ruyi for ten thousand years, illusion craft beyond compare. When she swears herself to you, her eyes curve—truth or glamour, who can tell? To bind her or free her: your call.
cultivation.fate.quhun.label: Qu Hun
cultivation.fate.quhun.story: From a corpse you forge the guardian soldier Quhun—iron-armored, fearless, thoughtless, yours to command. It stands silent at your cave mouth, more reliable than a thousand sworn oaths. Undying service, until the end of ends.
cultivation.fate.nangong.label: Nangong Wan
cultivation.fate.nangong.story: In Tiannan, an old friend waits—unchanged. Nangong Wan lifts her veil and smiles, and a thousand years of cultivation suddenly has an anchor. From now on your dao-heart holds firm; the inner demon finds no purchase.
cultivation.fate.fenglei.label: Wind-Thunder Wings
cultivation.fate.fenglei.story: After a thousand trials you claim the Wind-Thunder Wings. One beat—thunder rolls, a thousand li gone. Wandering the world and braving secret realms, distance means nothing now.
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.label: Profound Sky Fruit
cultivation.fate.xuanguo.story: The Profound Heaven Fruit ripens at last, auspicious light rising thirty li into the sky. One bite remakes body and soul—and fifty ancient relics answer your call besides. Ten thousand years on the Dao, and only the final tribulation remains.
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.label: Zhang Tie
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.story: Zhang Tie joined the sect the same day you did—quiet, honest, always taking the overseer's whip meant for you. Then one day he 'went home to his village.' Elder Mo said it lightly, but passing the cellar that night, you smelled herbs so thick they choked. The sound of chains on stone—you heard it once and never forgot it.
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.trace.hint: Face the truth in the cellar — Demon +5
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.trace: You pry open the cellar at midnight. Chains and medicine vats remain; he does not. At the bottom of a vat, dark residue settles—you finally understand what the Longevity Scripture's catalyst is. You'll remember this debt, and the cold sweat of that night. (Demon +5)
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.bide: You lower your eyes and keep grinding herbs as if you smelled nothing. But on rainy nights, that honest smile surfaces anyway, aching in your chest. (Demon +3)
cultivation.fate.jinguang.label: Cultivator Jinguang
cultivation.fate.jinguang.story: Disaster. The rogue cultivator Master Jinguang descends on Seven Mysteries with a talisman treasure, his golden aura proof against every blade. Sect disciples fall in heaps; the sect master's broken sword still stands in the training yard. Mortals cannot stop a cultivator. But you are no longer entirely mortal.
cultivation.fate.jinguang.fight.hint: Burn the golden light, debt repaid — Demon -8
cultivation.fate.jinguang.fight: You step off the eaves and a firebolt burns through the golden light. The survivors cheer; you simply flick your sleeve and leave. The jianghu will remember 'Li Feiyu'—and you and this sect are finally even. (Demon -8)
cultivation.fate.jinguang.flee: You grab your things and slip down the mountain as fire lights the sky behind you. Mortals and immortals walk different roads, you tell yourself—you can't save everyone. But that firelight colors your dreams for years. (Demon +6)
cultivation.fate.tainan.label: Tainan Gathering
cultivation.fate.tainan.story: Word reaches you of a rogue cultivators' meet in Tainan Valley. Disguised, you wander stalls of torn manuals, spirit-herb seeds, and beast bones, haggling voices all around—after years among immortals, this ordinary human bustle feels strangely unreal.
cultivation.fate.tainan.sword.hint: A few pages, whatever they yield — story only
cultivation.fate.tainan.sword: Ten spirit stones for a handful of torn sword-manual pages. By lamplight each character is a dead master's life's work—shame the crucial half-page is missing. Completion awaits another chance.
cultivation.fate.tainan.seed.hint: Plant them back at the cave — Demon -5
cultivation.fate.tainan.seed: You buy every spirit-herb seed on offer. With the little bottle, each seed becomes a medicine mountain—and at that thought, the string pulled tight in your chest loosens, just a little. (Demon -5)
cultivation.fate.chuansong.label: Ancient Teleport Array
cultivation.fate.chuansong.story: Deep in a sea-cave on a deserted island, an ancient teleportation array has lain ten thousand years, spirit-light still caught in its grooves. Restore it, and the far shore is the legendary Sea of Chaos—rampant beasts, boundless fortune.
cultivation.fate.chuansong.sail.hint: Step onto an unknown shore — story only
cultivation.fate.chuansong.sail: You burn through materials restoring the array, then step into its heart. White light—and the world is a hundred thousand li away. Salt wind hits your face; something huge cuts the distant sea. The Sea of Chaos.
cultivation.fate.chuansong.seal: You copy the full diagram and seal the cave behind wards. In chaotic times, a road out is worth more than treasure—and your dao-heart settles, knowing it exists. (Demon -20)
cultivation.fate.xutian.label: Void Heaven Palace
cultivation.fate.xutian.story: In the Void Heaven Palace's inner ice-vault, a primordial cultivator's treasures lie at your fingertips—the Qianlan Ice Flame's cold light, the Heaven-Mending Pill's age-old scent. The wards are failing. You can take only one. Decide.
cultivation.fate.xutian.flame.hint: The coldest fire refines your foundation — story only
cultivation.fate.xutian.flame: You bind the supreme cold flame with ice-arts. It enters your body and tempers your foundation to clarity—a wisp of ghost-blue on your fingertip, a trump card for the fights ahead.
cultivation.fate.xutian.pill.hint: A primordial pill calms the soul — Demon -10
cultivation.fate.xutian.pill: You seize the Heaven-Mending Pill—ten thousand years of potency condensed like jade. Swallowing it, coolness spreads through your soul; old wounds and stray obsessions quietly dissolve. (Demon -10)
cultivation.fate.erying.label: Second Nascent Soul
cultivation.fate.erying.story: By secret art you split your soul and raised a second nascent soul. It has your face but a souring temper—and lately it's been testing the seal at night. Keep it, and it's a calamity; free it, a bond; devour it, a tribulation. Time to settle it.
cultivation.fate.erying.merge.hint: Force-merge for a soul surge — Demon +10
cultivation.fate.erying.merge: You lay a soul-binding array and spend a hundred days refining the rebellious double into yourself. Your spirit surges—and so do the white hairs at your temple. Its last look at you was a mirror's. (Demon +10)
cultivation.fate.erying.release.hint: Unbind and let it fly — Demon -40
cultivation.fate.erying.release: You break the seal and let it carry a wisp of soul-light into the Sea of Chaos. Somewhere out there walks another 'you'—for good or ill, let fate decide. The moment you let go, the demon melts like spring snow. (Demon -40)
cultivation.msg.promoted: Promoted to {0} — sect resources are yours to command.
cultivation.sect.1.label: Seven Mysteries: Outer Disciple
cultivation.sect.1.desc: A humble beginning on the orthodox path.
cultivation.sect.2.label: Seven Mysteries: Inner Disciple
cultivation.sect.2.desc: Inner teachings unlocked — the sect's qi is yours to draw on.
cultivation.sect.3.label: Yellow Maple: Core Disciple
cultivation.sect.3.desc: Core disciples may enter the lower vaults of the library.
cultivation.sect.4.label: Yellow Maple: Enforcer Elder
cultivation.sect.4.desc: You hold the valley's discipline — half its spirit veins answer to you.
cultivation.sect.5.label: Luo Yun: Guardian Elder
cultivation.sect.5.desc: A guardian elder's word is law.
cultivation.sect.6.label: Luo Yun: Grand Elder
cultivation.sect.6.desc: Grand Elder — the apex of the sect; a continent's wealth is within reach.
cultivation.fate.mojuren.kill.hint: Cut the root, harden the heart — Demon -10
cultivation.fate.mojuren.kill: As he lunges, your blade is faster. Elder Mo falls with schemes still fading in his eyes. You burn the Soul-Seizing Art; the ash scatters into the mountain wind. That stroke severed more than a bond—it killed your last naivety. (Demon -10)
cultivation.fate.mojuren.spare.hint: Bind his remnant soul — it will stir your demon
cultivation.fate.mojuren.spare: You trap his scattering remnant soul inside a black-iron vessel. He's pragmatic—trades herb-lore for drops of soul tonic—but between the genuine lessons, there are always a few cold laughs.
cultivation.msg.mojuren.1: Dr. Mo's remnant whispers: 'Your foundation is full of holes, boy.' (demon grows)
cultivation.msg.mojuren.2: Dr. Mo sneers: 'Is this all you're worth?' (demon grows)
cultivation.msg.mojuren.3: Dr. Mo sighs: 'If only I had taken that body…' (demon grows)
cultivation.fate.xuese.loot.hint: Fill your pouch, keep your skin — Relic +10, Spice +1000
cultivation.fate.xuese.loot: You skirt the main melees and pick the quiet corners, your storage pouch swelling. When the gate seals you're thirty li away—the living are the only ones who get paid. (Relic +10, Spice +1000)
cultivation.fate.xuese.save.hint: Chivalry has a price — Karma +5, Relic +5, Demon -10
cultivation.fate.xuese.save: A junior sister is surrounded—you grind your teeth and fight back in, dragging her out through blood. Your name spreads through the sects, and somewhere inside, your dao-heart runs clearer. (Karma +5, Relic +5, Demon -10)
cultivation.fate.yinyue.bind.hint: A spirit servant graces the cave — All production +10%
cultivation.fate.yinyue.bind: Yinyue drops her glamour and bows into your service. Laughter drifts through the cave now; the pill room and forge are kept immaculate—all production +10%.
cultivation.fate.yinyue.free.hint: Freedom for freedom's sake — Karma +3, Demon -30
cultivation.fate.yinyue.free: You release the binding and return her freedom. The fox looks back once, then becomes silver light in the forest. Your heart settles like still water—some fates are only completed by letting go. (Karma +3, Demon -30)
cultivation.fate.feiyu.label: Li Feiyu
cultivation.fate.feiyu.story: On the Seven Mysteries training grounds, a disciple named Li Feiyu wields a saber like a demon and lives for the martial path. He doesn't know your cultivation secret—he just drags you out to drink and trade techniques. In chaotic times, such a friendship is a rare thing.
cultivation.fate.feiyu.oath.hint: A sworn bond steels the heart — Demon -5
cultivation.fate.feiyu.oath: You and Li Feiyu swear brotherhood under the moon. From now on there's someone inside these gates who'd watch your back—the immortal road is cold, and this warmth will last you years. (Demon -5)
cultivation.fate.feiyu.name.hint: Every wanderer needs an alias — story only
cultivation.fate.feiyu.name: You grin and file the name away. The jianghu legend of 'Li Feiyu, who kills and burns,' begins tonight—sorry, brother. Your name, I'll borrow it.
cultivation.fate.fengyun.label: Green Bamboo Bee-Cloud Swords
cultivation.fate.fengyun.story: From bamboo force-ripened in the green bottle, you forge seventy-two Azure Bamboo Cloudswarm Swords. Released together they blot out the sky like a wasp-cloud, thunder humming between them—no enemy will trouble your wanderings again.
cultivation.fate.chen.label: Chen Qiaoqian
cultivation.fate.chen.story: Senior Sister Chen of Yellow Maple Valley keeps inviting you out. Lamplight, herb-scent, her fingers trembling as she sorts your pill recipes—the affection is plain, and it has landed on a heart set on the Dao.
cultivation.fate.chen.dao: You gently refuse her. 'It's fine,' she smiles, but her sleeve hesitates as she turns. Years later you hear she never married, and passed with her lifespan spent—ripples spread across your dao-heart, refusing to still. (Demon +8)
cultivation.fate.chen.love: You take her hand beneath Yellow Maple's falling blossoms, and become dao-companions. The long immortal road now has a shared fire at its end—even the inner demon takes the long way around. (Demon -15)
cultivation.fate.dayan.label: Grandmaster Dayan
cultivation.fate.dayan.story: Inside a broken ancient puppet dwells a thousand-year remnant soul—Monarch Dayan, whose puppetry once walked unrivaled and whose spiritual sense few have ever matched. He has waited a millennium for someone who can hear him speak.
cultivation.fate.dayan.disciple: You bow three times, a disciple's salute. The monarch's remnant laughs, a thousand years of loneliness lifting, and pours his spiritual-sense legacy into you—the moment the Great Expansion Art takes root, you sense every mote of dust in your cave. (Demon -8)
cultivation.fate.dayan.puppet: You want the craft, not the bond. He snorts but teaches anyway—ironwood puppets now mine your mountains day and night. But puppetry draws on the soul; in quiet hours, your brow aches faintly. (Demon +6)
cultivation.fate.tihun.label: Weeping Soul Beast
cultivation.fate.tihun.story: Deep in the Sea of Chaos you acquire a strange beast—the Weeping Soul. It feeds on yin souls and vengeful spirits; one cry from its throat scatters a hundred ghosts. Henceforth your inner demon's phantoms are, to it, merely meals.
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.label: Yuan Yao
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.story: Yuanyao of the Yin Kui sect betrayed her school and walked alone into the nether death-lands to resurrect her fallen senior sister. The world calls her mad. You see instead the one who once crept into a cellar at night for Zhang Tie.
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.aid.hint: Give her the life-extending materials — Demon -12
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.aid: You hand over your most precious life-extending materials. Yuanyao bows deep and turns into the death-lands, unwavering. Her sister's revival is now your good karma too—few in this world will die for another. (Demon -12)
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.bond.hint: A confidante across the Sea — Demon -5
cultivation.fate.yuanyao.bond: You become kindred souls amid chaos—not romance, just the Dao walked together. Her Yin Kui connections span the Sea; rare curios and stranger rumors drift regularly to your cave. A true confidante is rarer than a dao-companion. (Demon -5)
cultivation.fate.xugu.label: Xuan Gu
cultivation.fate.xugu.story: Deep in the Void Heaven Palace, a white-jade skeleton opens its eyes—Xugu, the old devil who ruled these ruins ten thousand years ago. He offers partnership in the treasure hunt, voice mild, smile worse than his bones. Dance with the tiger—or flip the table?
cultivation.fate.xugu.ally.hint: Ally with the old devil — he'll help himself to your spirit stones
cultivation.fate.xugu.ally: You strike a pact and split the spoils. The old devil grins into black smoke—your relics multiply nicely. Only your spirit-stone stores seem... occasionally lighter.
cultivation.fate.xugu.slay.hint: Kill him while his soul is weak — Demon -15
cultivation.fate.xugu.slay: Mid-negotiation, you strike—gold beetles and thunderwings together. Xugu's curses cut short as his soul scatters to nothing. Ten thousand years of scheming, ended up as your pocket relics. (Demon -15)
cultivation.msg.xugu.gift: Xuan Gu tosses you a relic: 'Share and share alike, little friend.' (+{0} relics)
cultivation.msg.xugu.skim: Some spirit stones are missing — a note remains: 'Borrowed. Will repay.' (-{0} stones)
cultivation.fate.qingyuan.label: Qing Yuanzi
cultivation.fate.qingyuan.story: Deep in the Flying Spirit tribe's abyss you meet the remnant soul of Qingyuanzi, founder of the Azure Origin Sword Art you've practiced thirty years. 'Teachable,' the old master sighs, and pours his true sword insight into your dying flame—to hear the Dao in the morning, one may die at dusk content.
cultivation.fate.xiedao.label: Crab Daoist
cultivation.fate.xiedao.story: A golden crab-puppet of unknown origin walks up to your door, calling itself 'Daoist Crab.' Taciturn, unfathomably deep, paid only in thunder bamboo—for that, it quietly removes every trivial problem in your path. Such help comes once in ten thousand years.
cultivation.guide.hut: Build a thatched hut — a quiet cell that yields cultivation on its own
cultivation.guide.field: Open a spirit field — spirit grain trickles in to fuel wood refinement
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.wary.hint: Keep one eye on Elder Mo — story only
cultivation.fate.zhangtie.wary: Quietly, you swap the monthly 'tonic' Elder Mo gives you for plain water. Paranoid? Perhaps. But cultivators who survive this world are never the trusting kind.
cultivation.fate.feiyu.decline.hint: Mortals and immortals walk different roads — Demon +4
cultivation.fate.feiyu.decline: You decline his wine. Watching him walk off with the jug, you think: mortals live a few decades at best—why drag him into a cultivator's karma? The thought is colder than you expected. (Demon +4)
cultivation.fate.tainan.wine.hint: Tavern gossip maps the Sea of Chaos — story only
cultivation.fate.tainan.wine: You spend an afternoon in the valley tavern, hearing old rogue cultivators trade tales of the Sea of Chaos, the Void Heaven Palace, some devil's spectacular fall. Three parts drunk, the map of this world unfolds in your mind.
cultivation.fate.chen.forget: You neither refuse nor accept, only deferring her invitations again and again. Eventually she stops asking. Once, across a crowded market, you glimpse her back and almost step forward. Almost. (Demon +4)
cultivation.fate.erying.seal: You reinforce the seal and press it back into your soul-sea's depths. Inside, it laughs coldly: 'We are one—can you really cage me?' On nights to come, that laughter prowls the edges of your mind. (Demon +5)

cultivation.omen.ziqi: Purple qi drifts in from the east; auspicious clouds gather above your abode—heaven favors you.
cultivation.omen.ziqi.b: Violet haze rolls across the eastern sky, spirit-clouds coiling like a dragon. A most fortunate sign.
cultivation.omen.lingchao: A tide of spiritual energy wells up around your abode; the world's qi converges here.
cultivation.omen.lingchao.b: The earth-veins murmur like surf; mist seeps from the stone and wets your sleeve.
cultivation.omen.xinmo: A whisper rises in your heart: 'This is far enough. Why reach further?' Your dao-heart wavers.
cultivation.omen.xinmo.b: Deep in your sea of mind, an old friend's voice calls your name. You turn—only candlelight flickers.
cultivation.omen.hushen: A sect elder arrives to guard your rite, stilling the restless energies on every side.
cultivation.omen.hushen.b: Your sect-brothers weave a warding array; light closes over the abode like a bell.
cultivation.omen.gongming: Your opened spirit vein resonates with the abode's qi; the spring hums in time with your breath.
cultivation.omen.gongming.b: The vein's breathing falls into step with your circulation, and spirit qi pours back in.
cultivation.omen.pohou: Fine cracks already vein the barrier—fail or not, each crack remembers the way.
cultivation.omen.pohou.b: On the brink of breaking, you feel a hidden shell inside your meridians: break it, and the road is clear.
cultivation.omen.dunwu: Your sea of mind snaps into clarity; a thousand mysteries hang in view like morning stars. Now or never!
cultivation.omen.dunwu.b: A flash of insight—for an instant you glimpse a corner of the Great Dao. A perfect moment to ascend.
cultivation.omen.zouhuo: Your qi reverses course; your chest takes an invisible blow—deviation looms!
cultivation.omen.zouhuo.b: Your meridians burn and your qi scatters into chaos. To press on now invites disaster.
cultivation.msg.fail.1: The push for {0} fails! Torn meridians invite the heart-demon in (+{1})—yet you've traced the barrier's veins now. Next time comes easier.
cultivation.msg.fail.2: Your qi scatters three inches from the gate. {0} stands unreached and demons stir (+{1})—but defeat taught you its shape.
cultivation.msg.fail.3: A breath of true qi nearly dissipates into your limbs. The wall of {0} holds; demons grow (+{1})—still, each failure maps the gate more clearly.
cultivation.msg.fail.zouhuo: Deviation! Your qi surges backward and you cough blood. The assault on {0} ends in ruin—demons surge (+{1}), cultivation scatters. Rest and purge before you try again.
cultivation.msg.breakthrough.perfect: A flawless breakthrough! You enter {0} with an immaculate foundation and a lucid mind—your heart-demons are swept away.
